annotations.text:
Doctor's seat — tap, tap, done

THREE ARTBOARDS ARE LIVE: the seat (walk a whole consultation, switch patients in the rail), the complaint chips, and the F2 agent (tap the four questions).

Matched to the running app: IBM Plex Sans/Mono, hospital green #0e6b4e, gold for held-or-review, red for danger, paper #f4f7f4, and the shipped .pri/.sec/.pill/.box geometry.

Walk it: tap two complaints -> Assess -> tap the syndrome -> read the cards -> Accept -> follow-up -> Complete. The counter in the header is the instrument; 7 taps, nothing typed.

Then switch to Rekha in the rail and walk the same visit: the allergy swap fires, the pregnancy question is raised, and the QTc meter catches what the swap introduced.
